## Contribution Guidelines

- Don't submit code fully generated by AI. If you don't understand the code you are submitting, I don't want it.
- Make sure your code works, and that it does so on both the CLI and egui builds. [I wish I didn't have to specify either of these](https://github.com/RainbowCookie32/rusty-psn/pull/358).
- Keep communication human. I don't mind if you have to use a translator to communicate, I'll try my best to be clear and understand what you mean. But [I don't want to talk to an LLM](https://nomeatproxy.com/).
- Open an issue if you want to work on a new feature. We can discuss details, and it signals to any other potential contributors that it's already underway.
- Keep things civil. Should go without saying.

Failing to comply with any of these may result in you getting blocked from the repository. I might be more or less patient depending on the day, please don't test your luck.
